landing.tagline: Every fan's thank-you, in one beautiful reveal.
landing.demo.heading: See it come together.

landing.steps.send.title: Fans send their thanks.

landing.steps.reveal.title: Each cosplayer gets a link.
landing.steps.reveal.text: One private link that plays it all back, ready to keep or share.
landing.start.heading: Ready when you are.
landing.start.text: Name your event, enter your invite code, and your dashboard is ready.

admin.base.heading: Mosaic image
admin.base.text: The picture the fan photos assemble into: an event photo, booth shot, or art you have the rights to. Each cosplayer can also get their own image, so no two reveals show the same picture. A photo of them in costume works best: fan photos share its colors, so the mosaic matches far more closely. Only use a photo of someone with their OK; it's deleted on the same schedule as their submissions.

admin.settings.langNote: For fan pages, reveals, and printed signs. Anyone can still switch, and a browser set to English or Chinese is followed first. Signs always start in this language.
admin.settings.styleNote: Each cosplayer gets this unless you pick another on their page. Every style looks complete with any number of photos.
admin.settings.openNote: Closing the event starts the retention countdown.
admin.settings.confirmClose: Close the event? Fans will no longer be able to send anything, and the retention countdown starts.

demo.hub.title: FanWall demo
demo.hub.lead: Fans send a guest cosplayer photos and thank-you notes at an event. The organizer reviews them, then the cosplayer gets one link that plays them back as a mosaic. Everything here is made-up demo data, and nothing can be sent or saved.
demo.hub.revealText: What a cosplayer opens after the event. Press Play, then tap a photo or try Manage and Edit. Each one comes in all three styles; a real event uses the one its organizer picks.
demo.hub.fanText: What a fan sees after scanning the QR sign. Picking and editing a photo works; sending is off.
demo.hub.orgText: Review, approve, and hand out links. Approving and rejecting change this page only.
demo.case.yuki: Lots of photos of one costume, assembled over their own photo.
demo.case.aki: Lots of photos, assembled over the event image.
demo.case.rin: Only a handful of photos, still a complete picture.
demo.case.kai: What a cosplayer sees before the organizer releases their page.

owner.login.heading: Owner sign-in
owner.login.note: The OWNER_KEY set on the server. It is kept in this tab only, until you close it.
owner.invites.heading: Invite codes
owner.invites.intro: Give one code to each organizer. With it they can create their own events. A code works for 60 days unless you choose otherwise, and the events made with it close when it runs out. You can change the days left at any time. Each event has its own private dashboard link, so organizers never see each other's events.
owner.invites.labelNote: A name for you to recognize it, like the organizer or the convention. Please don't put an email here.
owner.invites.daysNote: 60 by default, up to 365. You can extend or shorten it later.
owner.invites.newNote: Copy it now. It is shown only once; the server keeps only a scrambled copy.
owner.invites.daysSaved: The code for {label} now works until {date}.
